dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Huh? Where's Dr. Baizhu? Hmm. I guess I'll just have to come back in a few days...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? What brings you to Bubu Pharmacy? Are you hurt anywhere? Or have you fallen ill and need medicine?

choices.text: I came over because I saw you were here.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Oh, nothing too serious. I just got distracted while descending a mountain a few days ago and sprained my ankle.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I ignored it at first, but the next morning, my ankle hurt so much it felt like it was going to split open. I couldn't even walk.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Fortunately, Ganyu came by to see me. She helped get Dr. Baizhu, and he applied some medicine.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Thanks to his excellent medical skills, I was out of bed and walking after just a few days. It doesn't even hurt now.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Almost, I'd say. I'm just here to get some nourishing herbs today.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Don't worry, I know my limits. I'm out doing land surveys almost every day, and I don't know how many scrapes and bruises I've gotten along the way. It's not a big deal.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Oh, looks like the doctor's here. I'll go get my medicine now, talk to you later.
